description:
Feeling distant from myself and being just a "normal" guy was devastating, but meeting Chloe, from the upper class, made me want a high-class life where real connections happen. Once, I was told, "You have potential, being the younger brother of Steve," though I still don't know what they owe my brother. For the first time, I felt like life might have something more to offer.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3776001394), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/high_class_person?p_id=pp_1601_001), [Toomics](https://toomics.com/click/intro?cno=7913&pid=webtoonguide), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9981227), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000058132), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230549)
